question: Which Indian state was named the "Go-To Global Destination for 2025" by the Wall Street Journal, highlighting its rich heritage and diverse wildlife?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Madhya Pradesh**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Madhya Pradesh** was named the "**Go-To Global Destination for 2025**" by the Wall Street Journal, reflecting its **rich heritage** and **diverse wildlife**.
 
• It is often referred to as the "**Heart of India**" due to its **central location** and **geographical significance**.
 
• The state is renowned for its **historical monuments**, including the **Khajuraho Temples**, **Sanchi Stupa**, and **Gwalior Fort**.
